statement: At pinned SDL revision, its Xbox One HIDAPI driver identifies Elite controllers as paddle-capable, provides four extra joystick buttons, and interprets USB GIP Elite Series 2 paddle state using 34-, 46- and 47-byte main-report variants or the 17-byte unmapped-state report path. It suppresses separate paddle presses when an onboard custom mapping would duplicate normal controls; these source paths do not prove host acceptance.

applicability.revision: Xbox Elite Series 2 model 1797, software-side revision at pinned sources
